The season started on 6 September 2021 and concluded on 28 May 2022.{{cite web |title=رسميًا.. الاتحاد السعودي يعلن موعد انطلاق الموسم الجديد |url=https://arabic.sport360.com/article/football/%d9%83%d8%b1%d8%a9-%d8%b3%d8%b9%d9%88%d8%af%d9%8a%d8%a9/1049420/%d8%b1%d8%b3%d9%85%d9%8a%d9%8b%d8%a7-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d8%b9%d9%88%d8%af%d9%8a-%d9%8a%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%86-%d9%85%d9%88%d8%b9%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%86%d8%b7%d9%84%d8%a7%d9%82-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d9%88%d8%b3%d9%85-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%ac%d8%af%d9%8a%d8%af}}{{cite web |title=انطلاق الموسم الجديد في سبتمبر المقبل |url=https://msl.sa/ar/node/1754}} All three teams were promoted on the final day of the season. [[Khaleej FC|Al-Khaleej]] were promoted and crowned champions following a 0–0 away draw with [[Najran SC|Najran]].{{cite web |title=الخليج بطل دوري «يلو» |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/769721}} [[Al-Adalah FC|Al-Adalah]] were promoted following a 0–0 draw away to [[Jeddah Club|Jeddah]].{{cite web |title=دوري يلو.. صعود الخليج والعدالة والوحدة إلى المحترفين |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/769675}} [[Al-Wehda Club (Mecca)|Al-Wehda]] were promoted following a 3–0 away win against [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]].{{cite web |title=صعود الخليج والعدالة والوحدة لدوري المحترفين والجيل والدرعية والكوكب والنهضة وبيشة إلى الثانية |url=https://www.al-jazirah.com/2022/20220529/sp9.htm}} [[Bisha FC|Bisha]] were the first team to be relegated on 5 May. They were relegated following a 2–1 defeat away to Al-Adalah.{{cite web |title=بيشة إلى «الثانية» |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/767264}} [[Al-Kawkab FC|Al-Kawkab]] were relegated a day later following a 2–0 home defeat to [[Al-Jabalain FC|Al-Jabalain]].{{cite web |title=ثنائية ترمي الكوكب إلى الثانية |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/767359}} [[Al-Nahda Club (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Nahda]] became the third side to be relegated following a 3–0 defeat away to [[Ohod Club|Ohod]] on 18 May.{{cite web |title=الصدارة مشتركة بين الخليج والعدالة أحد يوقع صك هبوط النهضة |url=https://lym.news/a/6397295}} On 23 May, [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]] became the fourth side to be relegated despite a 2–1 away win against Bisha.{{cite web |title=أرض المنافسين تحسم متأهلي Yelo |url=https://www.alwatan.com.sa/article/1107399}} On the final matchday, [[Al-Jeel Club|Al-Jeel]] became the fifth and final side to be relegated despite a 2–1 away win against Al-Nahda.{{cite web |title=الخليج والعدالة والوحدة لدوري المحترفين.. والجيل يرافق رباعي الهبوط |url=https://pressbee.net/show4674351.html?title=%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%AC-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%81%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%82-%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D8%A8%D9%88}} ==Overview== ===Changes=== On 9 October 2020, the Saudi FF announced that the number of teams in the league would be decreased to 18 starting from the 2022–23 season. To prepare for these changes it was announced that 5 teams would be relegated in the 2021–22 season and only 3 teams would be promoted from the [[2021–22 Saudi Second Division|2021–22 Second Division]].{{cite web |title=تقليص أندية دوري الأولى إلى 18 نادٍ ..و استحداث دوري الثالثة..و استبدال دوري المناطق بالدرجة الرابعة |date=9 October 2020|url=https://lym.news/a/6281594}} ===Rebrand=== On 26 August 2021, the newly appointed executive director of the FDL, Talal Al-Obaidi, announced a rebrand; beginning with the 2021–22 season, the competition would be known as the First Division League (FDL). As part of the rebranding, a new logo was introduced.{{cite web |title=FDL.. هوية دوري الأولى الجديدة |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/740930}}{{cite web |title=دوري الدرجة الأولى يطلق هويته الجديدة (FDL#). |url=https://twitter.com/FDL_KSA/status/1430806107233083397}} ===Name sponsorship=== On 1 September 2021, the FDL announced a sponsorship with car rental company [[Yelo Saudi Arabia|Yelo]]. As part of the sponsorship deal, the First Division League would be known as the Yelo League for the next 3 seasons.{{cite web |title=بحضور "القحطاني" و"العفالق".. إطلاق مسمّى "دوري يلو" على دوري الدرجة الأولى السعودي لكرة القدم |url=https://sabq.org/WpY2JP}}{{cite web |title=إطلاق مسمّى (دوري يلو) على الدرجة الأولى السعودي |url=https://msl.sa/ar/node/1760}} ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division since the 2021–22 season. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} ===To the First Division League=== '''Promoted from [[2020–21 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Okhdood Club|Al-Okhdood]] * [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]] * [[Al-Kholood Club|Al-Kholood]] * [[Bisha FC|Bisha]] '''Relegated from [[2020–21 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] * [[Al-Wehda Club (Mecca)|Al-Wehda]] * [[Al-Ain FC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Ain]] {{col-break|gap=3em}} ===From the First Division League=== '''Promoted to [[2021–22 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] * [[Al-Fayha FC|Al-Fayha]] * [[Al-Tai FC|Al-Tai]] '''Relegated to [[2021–22 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Bukayriyah FC|Al-Bukayriyah]] * [[Al-Thoqbah Club|Al-Thoqbah]] * [[Arar FC|Arar]] * [[Al-Nojoom FC|Al-Nojoom]] {{col-end}} ==Teams== A total of 20 teams are contesting the league, including 13 sides from the [[2020–21 Prince Mohammad bin Salman League|2020–21 season]], 4 promoted teams from the [[2020–21 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] and the three relegated sides from the [[2020–21 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]. The first club to be relegated to the First Division League was [[Al-Ain FC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Ain]], who were relegated after only a year in the top flight 2–0 defeat away to [[Al-Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]] on 14 May 2021.{{cite web |title=رسميا.. العين اول الهابطين من الدوري السعودي للمحترفين |url=https://alwafd.news/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B6%D8%A9/3742665-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%81%D9%8A%D9%86}} In the final matchday, both [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] and [[Al-Wehda Club (Mecca)|Al-Wehda]] were relegated following a draw with [[Abha Club|Abha]] and a loss against [[Al-Shabab FC (Riyadh)|Al-Shabab]] respectively.{{cite web |title=الوحدة والقادسية يودعان.. وضمك والباطن وأبها ينجون |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/731383}} Al-Qadsiah were relegated after only a year in the top flight while Al-Wehda were relegated after three years in the top flight. The first club to be promoted was [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]] who were promoted despite a 1–0 away defeat to [[Afif FC|Afif]] on 27 March 2021.{{cite web |title=العروبة يصعد رسمياً لدوري الأمير محمد بن سلمان للدرجة الأولى |date=28 March 2021|url=https://www.al-madina.com/article/724964/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B6%D8%A9/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%B5%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF-%D8%A8%D9%86-%D8%B3%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%89}} On 3 April 2021, both [[Al-Okhdood Club|Al-Okhdood]] and [[Bisha FC|Bisha]] were promoted. Al-Okhdood were promoted following a 1–1 draw with [[Al-Taqadom FC|Al-Taqadom]] while Bisha were promoted following a 2–0 win over [[Al-Jandal Club|Al-Jandal]].{{cite web |title=صعود الأخدود وبيشة إلى دوري الأمير محمد بن سلمان لأندية الدرجة الأولى |url=https://sabq.org/4RPdkh}} The final club to be promoted was [[Al-Kholood Club|Al-Kholood]], who were promoted following a 3–1 away win over [[Al-Dahab Club|Al-Dahab]] in the final matchday.{{cite web |title=الخلود يُكمل عقد الصاعدين لدوري الأمير محمد بن سلمان |url=https://ajel.sa/nMtjdF/}} [[Al-Okhdood Club|Al-Okhdood]] defeated [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]] 4–2 on penalties (3–3 after extra time) to win their second title and first since 1992.{{cite web |title=القاسم يتوج الأخدود ببطولة دوري الدرجة الثانية بعد انتصاره على العروبة |url=https://www.saff.com.sa/news.php?id=774}} Al-Kholood and Bisha will play in the [[Saudi First Division League|First Division League]] for the first time in their history. Al-Orobah return after an absence of two seasons and will play in their 13th overall season in the First Division League. Al-Okhdood return to the First Division League for the first time since the 1992–93 season. They will play in their 2nd season in the First Division League. ===Stadia and locations===
